acceptanceCriteria: make spec-acceptance-audit reports UNPARSED_STANDING 0 on the merged tree
the standing count equals the previous standing count plus the moved markers and the owner/unrecorded counts are otherwise unchanged
spec-requirements-check and the 12 doc gates stay green
body: Observed 2026-10-13 in lane V1-1346+V1-1347 (PR beamfall/corvint#864). SRG-V0-009..010 parse the acceptance mode from the leading parenthetical of a requirement's definition line. `make spec-acceptance-audit` on BASE 523fa4ce6 reports UNPARSED_STANDING for 52 requirements in 5 specs whose standing marker sits at the end of the line; they are counted as `unrecorded` and NOT_PROMOTABLE cannot see them. Expected: the markers sit in the leading parenthetical (same wording), the audit reports 0 UNPARSED_STANDING and the standing count rises by 52. Actual: 52 UNPARSED_STANDING rows. Prose-only change; REQUIREMENTS.tsv columns 5-6 regenerate via make spec-requirements. Run the audit (`make spec-acceptance-audit`) to list the exact rows; do not alter requirement text or IDs.
title: specs: move the 52 trailing standing-acceptance markers in 5 specs to the leading parenthetical so the acceptance audit counts them
